parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. I understand you’re seeing a production impact: your dashboard shows **“retries exhausted” for 118 production-order events**, and your webhook endpoint has stopped receiving them. You’re also asking whether we can **replay the missing events**.

We’ll escalate this for investigation on our side, but to determine the best replay path and avoid any further gaps, could you please confirm the following:
1) **Which environment(s)** are affected (production only, or also staging/test)?
2) The **time range** when the events stopped arriving and when the “retries exhausted” status began.
3) The **exact webhook endpoint/resource** impacted (URL path or integration name, if you have multiple).
4) The **identifiers** for the 118 failed events (event IDs and/or the related production order IDs, plus timestamps if available).
5) If you have them: the **HTTP status codes and response bodies** you received during the failure period (or any relevant logs/timeouts).
6) Whether you have any information indicating changes on your side (even if you believe none occurred) such as **auth/certificate/config updates** that could affect webhook delivery.

Once we have those details, we can check whether a **replay is available** for those specific failed events and what constraints apply (e.g., idempotency and any replay window/rate limits).
promised_actions: Escalate the issue for human review and investigation.
Check whether a replay is possible for the identified failed webhook events once the requested details are provided.
safety_notes: Avoid promising replay or determining root cause until we review event delivery logs and constraints.
Ask for minimal but necessary identifiers/time range and environment to target replay safely.
Do not claim any SLA, refund, or legal/security determination.

parsed.customer_impact: Production-order events are not being delivered via webhooks, and 118 events failed after retries were exhausted; this can leave downstream systems with missing or stale order state.
grounded_facts: The customer’s order webhook endpoint has stopped receiving events from the customer’s system.
The customer dashboard indicates “retries exhausted” for 118 events.
The affected events are described as “production orders.”
The customer states they changed nothing on their side.
The customer requests the missing events to be replayed if possible.
The ticket category is “integration_failure” and needs human review.
missing_information: Which environment(s) are affected (production only vs also staging/test)?
The time range when events stopped and when the “retries exhausted” condition began.
Which specific webhook endpoint URL/resource is affected (if multiple endpoints exist).
Any identifiers of the 118 events (event IDs/order IDs, timestamps) to target replay.
Whether the customer can confirm any correlation with recent changes on your side (e.g., deployments, configuration, auth/cert changes), despite the statement “changed nothing on our side.”
Webhook response details (HTTP status codes, error bodies, timeout/logs) from either your system or the customer’s system at the time of failure.
Whether a replay mechanism exists and what constraints apply (rate limits, idempotency, supported replay windows).
risk_signals: High urgency due to production impact and missing events.
Potential integration reliability issue causing repeated delivery failures (retries exhausted).
Ambiguity about whether the issue is on your side vs the customer side (customer reports no changes).
Risk of further data inconsistencies if replay cannot be performed or is incomplete.
parsed.summary: The customer reports that their production-order webhook endpoint is no longer receiving events from your system and a dashboard indicates retries were exhausted for 118 events, requesting a replay of the missing events.
